reproduce.additional_source_cache_setup: Save source_cache_python below as .runtime/prepare_parity_sources.py and run .venv/bin/python .runtime/prepare_parity_sources.py. It only fetches and verifies pinned bytes; it does not execute upstream code.
reproduce.source_cache_python:
import hashlib, json, pathlib, urllib.request
commit = "6f0acb414a5f1ab070aa62d02ac98f2602011821"
base = pathlib.Path(".runtime/learned-model")
(base / "upstream").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
tree_url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/EvanMcCormick37/ml-homewall-climb-generator/git/trees/{commit}?recursive=1"
with urllib.request.urlopen(tree_url, timeout=60) as response:
    tree = json.load(response)
assert tree["sha"] == commit and not tree["truncated"]
entries = {row["path"]: row for row in tree["tree"]}
sources = {
    "ddpm_model.py": ("60f3f6c691bf2808bfc0747858794a2d1cdeca16", "f95f15b41b14b6d3495e6d8864ddab17967d32a243d7adde075b2ea9ed103509", 11148),
    "generation_utils.py": ("5df4faee5f6bc0e9eea3ab2aecb31b82cf9bd0ed", "1a12bb82020fe3ad7ef44a7445960478eea8232559fff6b6447eed921bd2f2e6", 16183),
}
for name, (blob, sha256, size) in sources.items():
    source_path = "climb-backend/app/services/utils/" + name
    entry = entries[source_path]
    assert entry["type"] == "blob" and entry["sha"] == blob and entry["size"] == size
    url = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EvanMcCormick37/ml-homewall-climb-generator/{commit}/{source_path}"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as response:
        data = response.read(size + 1)
    assert len(data) == size and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == sha256
    assert hashlib.sha1(f"blob {len(data)}\0".encode() + data).hexdigest() == blob
    (base / "upstream" / name).write_bytes(data)
(base / "tree.json").write_text(json.dumps(tree) + "\n")
print("Pinned parity sources prepared; no downloaded code has been executed.")
